# Slid Phi Labs
> Tools a person can try for 24 hours, then buy. The rent desk is retired.

- Chamber — lock a JSON secret so two keys are required to open it. $9 / $49 / $490.
- TRU8 — compress a file and get it back exactly. 10k zeros → 8 B. $19 / $99 / $990 (year includes Chamber). Not a claim we beat brotli on every file.
- Gate — mixed files: text → brotli-11, else gzip-9. $29 / $89 / $790. Not #1 general compressor.
- Lab Pass — Chamber + TRU8 + Gate + TruGame for 365 days. $1,088. Then it ends.
- TruGame — engine, not a store. Month $12 · Year $79. No $3.99 / 7-day SKU.
- Suite — pay by the gigabyte. First 100 GB free, then ~5¢ / 4¢. Not a seat.
- Quikgater — pay-per-fact agent fetch. Live worker. Not a compressor.
- ZRW core git is private (not a public dump). Host works on it.
